synthetic_notice: Generated observations; not real vessel broadcasts or public source data.

geographic_scope.label: Configured Port of Los Angeles synthetic development geofence (not a real-world port identity claim)
geographic_scope.identification_method: Synthetic coordinates are generated inside the configured development geofence; they do not verify a real port or AIS source.

target_definitions.SyntheticCongestionLabel: Simulated congestion label driven by queue-to-capacity pressure, anchorage count, and adverse weather.
target_definitions.SyntheticDelayLabel: Simulated delay label derived from SyntheticDelayMinutes >= 60; delay minutes depend on queue pressure, weather, wind, and seeded noise.

synthetic_process.anchorage_dwell_hours: For qualifying low-speed geofence observations, repeated records for the same vessel/day span a simulated duration; not ground-truth waiting time.
synthetic_process.daily_conditions: Arrivals, berth capacity, queue, anchorage share, weather, and wind vary by season, traffic, and seeded random variation.

target_source: SyntheticCongestionLabel column in the source dataset; aggregated by UTC day using max value.
target_definition: The uploaded synthetic congestion label is used as the binary target when it is supplied and valid.
delay_target_source: SyntheticDelayLabel in the source dataset, aggregated by UTC day using max.
